name: design_harness
description: Design and create a brand new harness template from scratch. This allows you to define a custom multi-agent pipeline with arbitrary nodes, edges, and agent slots. The harness is saved to disk and can immediately be used with create_harness. Use list_harness_templates first to see existing templates and avoid duplication.

name.description: Unique name for the harness template (snake_case, e.g. 'research_debate', 'code_review_pipeline')

description.description: Human-readable description of what this harness does and when to use it

slots.description: Agent slot definitions. Keys are slot names, values are objects with 'description' (string) and optionally 'required' (boolean, default true). Example: {"worker": {"description": "主执行者", "required": true}, "reviewer": {"description": "审查者"}}

pipeline.description: Pipeline definition with 'start' (string, first node name), 'max_steps' (int, default 100), and 'nodes' (object). Each node has 'op' (one of: '等待输入', '推理', '处理工具', '处理文字', '执行工具'), 'agent' (slot name, required for 推理/处理工具/处理文字/执行工具), and 'edges' (array of {condition, to}). Conditions: 'input', 'has_tool_calls', 'no_tool_calls', 'has_text', 'default'.

prompts.description: Optional reusable prompt templates. Keys are prompt names, values are prompt text strings. Nodes can reference these via 'prompt' field.

return_mode.description: What to return when harness completes: 'all' (entire conversation) or 'last' (final message only). Default: 'all'.
